Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the walk-through this morning. We want to lock the final MAP and confirm the sign-off path so we can hit the internal date of Aug 2 (first production weekend). Procurement asked that we put a 48-hour review window on the legal/exec ask — essentially a hard cut at end-of-day Monday for final internal approvals.

Could you confirm:
- Redwood signatory availability (who will countersign and typical SLA for routing)?
- DocuSign window length you need (we prefer 3 business days but can be shorter if you can guarantee countersign same-day).

Thanks,

Tom —

Appreciate the clear timing. Short answers up front:
- Countersign: Naomi Feldman (VP, Sales Ops) will countersign; legal review is with Karthik and we can countersign same-business-day if legal clears.
- DocuSign window: we can set a 48-hour DocuSign expiry with a targeted same-day countersign on Redwood's side; if Orlion needs 72 hours we can extend but we prefer 48 to keep the timeline tight.
- Gate checks: current blockers I see are
  1) Final SOC 2 evidence (we have the report; Orlion asked for a scoped extract — Karthik will confirm delivery ETA)
  2) Dedicated pool sizing confirmation (engineering confirms capacity reservation for Aug 2 — Marissa has the final quota check)
  3) Onboarding doc pull (API keys and network allowlist) — typically a 24–48hr activity after e-sign.

Proposed quick MAP update (48hr sprint):
- Sat (today) 09:00–12:00: finalize redlines (Orlion legal + Redwood legal)
- Sat 13:00: Redwood legal gives go/no-go on countersign same-day or requests 24hr extension
- Mon 09:00: DocuSign live (48hr window)
- Mon 13:00: Redwood countersign target (if redlines cleared)
- Tue 08:00: Onboarding kickoff; aim for Aug 2 soft-launch on reserved pool

I attached a suggested e-sign envelope and a single-page MAP extract to slot into your internal tracker. If procurement insists on a 72-hour signer window, note that will push our target countersign to Tue and may compress the onboarding prep to 24 hours.

I can be on call this afternoon for any legal huddles.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
